# LazyTopper

> LazyTopper is a CBSE Class 10 board-exam preparation web app for Maths and Science, for students in India. Students check their written answers step by step, the way a CBSE examiner marks them, and practise with chapter notes, competency-based questions and chapter-wise exam trends drawn from ten years of CBSE board papers.

Key facts:
- Audience: students preparing for the CBSE Class 10 board exam (2026-27 session, boards in 2027), and their parents.
- Subjects: Class 10 Maths and Science only, on the current CBSE syllabus.
- Check & Improve: a student photographs or uploads a written answer and sees the marks for every step and where marks were lost. The first check is free without an account.
- Free without an account: chapter notes, chapter pages, Exam Trends, the CBSE Class 10 papers page and the practice hub.
- Signing up starts a 7-day Premium trial with no card needed; after it the student keeps the free Basic plan or upgrades to Premium.
- High-probability questions show the question patterns that recur in past CBSE papers. LazyTopper does not claim to know the questions of any upcoming exam.
- LazyTopper is an independent platform and is not affiliated with CBSE.

## Start here
- [Home](https://www.lazytopper.com/app/): what LazyTopper does, and a free answer check
- [Exam Trends](https://www.lazytopper.com/app/exam-trends): every Class 10 chapter ranked by exam weightage, from ten years of CBSE board papers
- [CBSE Class 10 Boards 2027](https://www.lazytopper.com/app/cbse/class-10): official CBSE papers for Class 10 Maths and Science, unit-wise marks, dates and exam rules
- [Practice hub](https://www.lazytopper.com/app/practice-hub): choose a subject and chapter, then practise questions, worksheets or mock papers
- [Class 10 Maths predicted questions](https://www.lazytopper.com/app/highly-probable/10/Maths): high-probability question patterns for the 2027 boards, chapter by chapter
- [Class 10 Science predicted questions](https://www.lazytopper.com/app/highly-probable/10/Science): high-probability question patterns for the 2027 boards, chapter by chapter
- [Pricing](https://www.lazytopper.com/app/pricing): what the free plan includes and what Premium adds
